requirements.text: Strong fullstack experience, comfortable working across systems, stacks, and distributed systems rather than a single layer.
A track record of delivering large projects and complex work in a timely manner.
Experience collaborating closely with Product and Design to work through scope, risks, and open questions before and during delivery.
An agile mindset; you’re comfortable learning new technologies, adapting quickly, and doing what it takes to ship when the situation calls for it.
4+ years of professional experience building complex, production-grade fullstack applications, including high-volume, real-time systems at scale.
Deep proficiency with modern fullstack technologies such as React/TypeScript, ElasticSearch, Redis, and AWS.
Demonstrated technical leadership: ****you’ve led projects, driven alignment, and delivered outcomes across multiple stakeholders.
A strong ownership mindset: you take responsibility for outcomes end-to-end, including reliability, maintainability, and post-launch iteration.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills: you articulate tradeoffs clearly and work effectively with cross-functional partners.
Pragmatic problem-solving: you understand tradeoffs and value shipping iteratively without sacrificing long-term quality.

Implement end-to-end delivery of high-impact, complex initiatives. Own technical execution from problem framing, decision making, and scoping through implementation, launch, and iteration — across Front's stack.
Drive technical direction across the stack. Influence architecture, API design, and performance strategy for high-traffic, distributed workflows like inbox triage.

Raise the bar for quality and maintainability. Improve testing, observability, and engineering standards across frontend and backend. Reduce regressions and enable faster iteration through better tooling and code health.

Grow others and strengthen the team. Give and receive feedback well, provide mentorship and constructive code review, share best practices, and help create a collaborative, low-ego engineering culture.
